zjs.globals_install_note: The internal harness splits the production JSContext.create sequence around construction-only core Realm creation and the real materializer/contextGlobal bootstrap; context_create_ns retains the complete public-ready boundary.

phase_definitions.context_create_ns: Create one public-ready context, retained as the backward-compatible complete Realm boundary.
phase_definitions.globals_install_ns: Install standard globals separately when the engine API exposes that boundary; otherwise null.
phase_definitions.realm_raw_create_ns: Create the construction-only core Realm before any global object or intrinsic graph exists; zjs-internal attribution only.
phase_definitions.realm_bootstrap_ns: Run the real contextGlobal path through intrinsic installation and Realm publication; zjs-internal attribution only.
phase_definitions.realm_ready_ns: Outer public-constructor-equivalent boundary: facade allocation, standard-global/materializer registration, raw Realm, contextGlobal bootstrap, and GC-threshold restoration; equal to context_create_ns in this harness.
phase_definitions.compile_ns: Complete parser.compile boundary through canonical FunctionBytecode publication; parse_ns is the retained internal alias.
phase_definitions.compile_frontend_ns: Lexer, parser, and pre-finalization bytecode work inside parser.compile.
phase_definitions.compile_finalize_ns: Recursive FunctionBytecode finalization and canonical artifact creation inside parser.compile.
phase_definitions.root_function_publish_ns: Create the ordinary script root function object and publish its value-root frame.
phase_definitions.first_execute_ns: From the compiled ordinary root through root-function publication and the first completed top-level VM run; the existing eval-epilogue root-function-value release remains outside this phase, unlike QuickJS JS_EvalFunction cleanup.
phase_definitions.vm_run_ns: Stack setup plus the first top-level VM run, excluding root-function publication.
phase_definitions.promise_jobs_ns: Immediate post-top-level drain performed inside context.eval and included in eval_total_ns; zjs also polls host signal, I/O, timer, and Atomics completion queues.
phase_definitions.final_job_drain_ns: Drain after all warmup and timed run invocations; zjs also polls its host queues.
phase_definitions.engine_cold_to_first_result_ns: Outer boundary from runtime creation start through the first completed top-level context.eval result; source I/O is excluded.
phase_definitions.eval_total_ns: Outer ordinary-global-script boundary around the complete context.eval call, its immediate job/host-queue drain, and subsequent completion-value release.
phase_definitions.steady_execute: After warmup, each sample times one call to the retained run function; the source is never recompiled.
phase_definitions.job_drain_ns: Sum of pending-job drain time immediately after top-level execution and after all run invocations.
phase_definitions.context_destroy_ns: Destroy the context only in leak-check mode; null in normal mode.
phase_definitions.runtime_destroy_ns: Destroy the runtime only in leak-check mode; null in normal mode.
